section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study (Study X) conducted in Hong Kong that evaluated the conceptual equivalence of a Chinese (Cantonese) translation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among 1319 women and 1084 men. The study found that a modified two-dimensional structure of the BAS had the best fit, with one factor, General Body Appreciation, showing good construct validity through significant correlations with BMI and self-esteem. The results suggest potential cultural differences in the concept of body appreciation.
